Popular subjects and courses to get you started
Popular subjects
Algebra I
Linear equations, factoring and graphing — the foundation everything in high school math builds on.
Geometry
Proofs, theorems and constructions, plus the area, volume and trigonometry that come with them.
Trigonometry
The unit circle, identities and graphs that make trig click before it resurfaces in calculus.
Precalculus
Functions, trigonometry and conics, bridging Algebra II and the calculus courses that follow it.
Statistics
Probability, distributions and regression, taught through real data sets rather than abstract formulas.
AP Calculus AB
Limits, derivatives and integrals at the pace and depth the AB exam covers.
AP Calculus BC
Everything in AB plus series, polar curves and parametric equations for the extended BC syllabus.
AP Physics 1
Algebra-based mechanics, waves and basic circuits, built around the exam's experimental-design questions.
AP Physics C
Calculus-based mechanics and electromagnetism for students taking the full Physics C sequence.
IGCSE Maths
Core or Extended tier content, with the non-calculator reasoning Cambridge papers emphasize.
IGCSE Physics
Forces, energy and waves taught to Cambridge's syllabus, with practical-paper technique included.
PSLE Maths
Model-method problem sums and the multi-step reasoning Singapore's PSLE paper is known for.
PSLE Science
Diversity, systems, cycles and interactions — the four themes the PSLE science syllabus is organized around.
Cambridge English Exam Prep
Reading, writing, listening and speaking practice for Cambridge qualifications like FCE and CAE.
UK National Curriculum Tutoring
Key Stage 3 and 4 support across core subjects, aligned to the syllabus a student's school is actually teaching.
US Common Core Tutoring
Subject support across the standard American middle and high school sequence, mapped to grade-level standards.
IB Diploma Programme Support
Cross-subject support for Diploma students juggling HL/SL courses, TOK, the Extended Essay and internal assessments.
